ANSWER_KEY_IN_LEARNER_TEXT|MAJOR.issue: Answers sit in the learner-facing text, so assessment evidence is not independent.
ANSWER_KEY_IN_LEARNER_TEXT|MAJOR.proposedCorrection: Move keys to the protected reviewer/teacher projection; never deliver them to learners.

ARITHMETIC_ERROR|BLOCKING.issue: Stated arithmetic is wrong; learners would copy an incorrect result.
ARITHMETIC_ERROR|BLOCKING.proposedCorrection: Correct the stated result to the computed value in the evidence, then re-check every dependent step and answer.

ARITHMETIC_ERROR|MAJOR.issue: Stated arithmetic is wrong; learners would copy an incorrect result.
ARITHMETIC_ERROR|MAJOR.proposedCorrection: Correct the stated result to the computed value in the evidence, then re-check every dependent step and answer.

DEMO_OR_TEST_FIXTURE_IN_CATALOG|BLOCKING.issue: A demo or smoke-test lesson sits in the production catalog alongside curriculum content.
DEMO_OR_TEST_FIXTURE_IN_CATALOG|BLOCKING.proposedCorrection: A curriculum owner decides: retire from the learner catalog (keeping history rows resolvable) or keep as a labelled demo. It is not modernized as curriculum.

DENSE_SECTION|MAJOR.issue: Sections carry more text than one scene can present without overload.
DENSE_SECTION|MAJOR.proposedCorrection: Split into scenes with one idea each and move teacher-only material out of learner text.

DENSE_SECTION|MINOR.issue: Sections carry more text than one scene can present without overload.
DENSE_SECTION|MINOR.proposedCorrection: Split into scenes with one idea each and move teacher-only material out of learner text.

DUPLICATE_LEARNER_TEXT|MAJOR.issue: The same learner text is catalogued as more than one lesson.
DUPLICATE_LEARNER_TEXT|MAJOR.proposedCorrection: Choose one canonical lesson; map the others to it in the legacy mapping plan (never delete referenced rows).

DUPLICATE_TITLE|MINOR.issue: Several lessons share a title in the same grade and subject; learners and teachers cannot tell them apart.
DUPLICATE_TITLE|MINOR.proposedCorrection: Disambiguate titles or consolidate in the modernization plan.

LAB_WITHOUT_OFFLINE_FALLBACK|MINOR.issue: Learners without a device or connection lose the lab's objective.
LAB_WITHOUT_OFFLINE_FALLBACK|MINOR.proposedCorrection: Add an objective-preserving paper or text walkthrough fallback.

LONG_PARAGRAPHS|MINOR.issue: Long unbroken paragraphs raise reading load.
LONG_PARAGRAPHS|MINOR.proposedCorrection: Break into short paragraphs, lists or labelled steps.

NO_DELAYED_RETRIEVAL|MAJOR.issue: Nothing checks whether learning lasts beyond the lesson.
NO_DELAYED_RETRIEVAL|MAJOR.proposedCorrection: Add a retention blueprint: retrieval items for each mastery objective at ≥7 days (LM-ASM-3).

NO_END_OF_LESSON_ASSESSMENT|MAJOR.issue: Nothing checks whether learners met the objectives.
NO_END_OF_LESSON_ASSESSMENT|MAJOR.proposedCorrection: Add an independent end-of-lesson demonstration covering every objective.

NO_EXTENSION_PATH|MINOR.issue: Ready learners have nowhere to go beyond the objective.
NO_EXTENSION_PATH|MINOR.proposedCorrection: Add an optional, non-gating extension clearly labelled as beyond grade scope.

NO_FALLBACK_ROUTE|MAJOR.issue: The prerequisite is mentioned but not diagnosed with a fallback, so learners without it fall behind unseen.
NO_FALLBACK_ROUTE|MAJOR.proposedCorrection: Turn activation into a diagnostic item per prerequisite and state what happens when a learner misses it.

NO_GUIDED_PRACTICE|MAJOR.issue: Learners go from watching to working alone with no supported attempt.
NO_GUIDED_PRACTICE|MAJOR.proposedCorrection: Add guided items with partial support and feedback (Track B).

NO_INDEPENDENT_PRACTICE|MAJOR.proposedCorrection: Add unscaffolded practice for each objective (Track B).

NO_LIBERIAN_CONTEXT|MINOR.issue: No task applies the objective to a Liberian situation.
NO_LIBERIAN_CONTEXT|MINOR.proposedCorrection: Add at least one authentic Liberian application; label invented data as invented.

NO_MISCONCEPTION_SPECIFIC_FEEDBACK|MAJOR.issue: Wrong answers cannot be diagnosed or corrected by cause.
NO_MISCONCEPTION_SPECIFIC_FEEDBACK|MAJOR.proposedCorrection: Map each distractor or response pattern to a catalogued misconception with corrective feedback.

NO_MISCONCEPTION_TEACHING|MAJOR.issue: Common errors are neither taught against nor anticipated.
NO_MISCONCEPTION_TEACHING|MAJOR.proposedCorrection: Catalogue the objective's misconceptions and teach against each (Track A).

NO_MOE_MAPPING|MAJOR.issue: No objective is traced to the MOE curriculum.
NO_MOE_MAPPING|MAJOR.proposedCorrection: Map each objective to a structured MOE objective id with source page, reviewed by a curriculum owner; lexical leads are attached to this audit.

NO_MOE_SOURCE_FOR_SUBJECT|BLOCKING.issue: There is no verified MOE curriculum to trace this lesson's objectives to; its scope is LiberiaLearn-originated.
NO_MOE_SOURCE_FOR_SUBJECT|BLOCKING.proposedCorrection: A curriculum owner records a scope decision (adopt as LiberiaLearn enrichment with owned objectives, or retire). Until then: governance hold (Track D).

NO_PREREQUISITE_CHECK|MAJOR.issue: Instruction assumes prerequisites it never checks.
NO_PREREQUISITE_CHECK|MAJOR.proposedCorrection: Add a short diagnostic per prerequisite with a stated route for learners who lack it.

NO_REASONING_TASK|MAJOR.issue: Learners are never asked to produce reasoning, only answers.
NO_REASONING_TASK|MAJOR.proposedCorrection: Add a constructed-response reasoning or performance task at scaffold NONE scored by a rubric.

NO_SCENE_STRUCTURE|MAJOR.issue: The text has no scene structure for slideshow pagination; it would render as one long slide.
NO_SCENE_STRUCTURE|MAJOR.proposedCorrection: Restructure into scenes with one purpose each (V2 scene contract).

NO_SCENE_STRUCTURE|MINOR.issue: The text has no scene structure for slideshow pagination; it would render as one long slide.
NO_SCENE_STRUCTURE|MINOR.proposedCorrection: Restructure into scenes with one purpose each (V2 scene contract).

NO_TRANSFER_TASK|MAJOR.issue: Learners are only tested in rehearsed contexts, so transfer is unknown.
NO_TRANSFER_TASK|MAJOR.proposedCorrection: Add an unscaffolded transfer task in a context the lesson did not rehearse (GE-TRN-1).

NO_WAEC_BASELINE_MAPPING|MAJOR.issue: No verified WAEC syllabus source is held in the repository, so examination alignment cannot be stated beyond 'topic may be relevant'.
NO_WAEC_BASELINE_MAPPING|MAJOR.proposedCorrection: Obtain and register the official WAEC syllabus for the subject, then map with stated specificity and NOT_CLAIMED status.

NO_WORKED_EXAMPLE|MAJOR.issue: Learners never see the method modelled before practising it.
NO_WORKED_EXAMPLE|MAJOR.proposedCorrection: Add at least two worked examples that fade support (Track B).

OBJECTIVES_UNDER_ASSESSED|MINOR.issue: Some objectives cannot have their own assessment evidence.
OBJECTIVES_UNDER_ASSESSED|MINOR.proposedCorrection: Assess every objective at least once at the end of the lesson.

PLACEHOLDER_CONTENT|BLOCKING.issue: The lesson is a template shell: sections say what to teach ("Model one complete example…") but contain no explanation, example or item.
PLACEHOLDER_CONTENT|BLOCKING.proposedCorrection: Replace with a full candidate lesson (Track C); keep the legacy revision for history.

POSSIBLE_SUBJECT_MISLABEL|MAJOR.issue: The content reads as a different subject from its catalogue label, so it may be mis-mapped.
POSSIBLE_SUBJECT_MISLABEL|MAJOR.proposedCorrection: A curriculum reviewer confirms the subject; a confirmed mis-mapping moves the lesson to Track C (replace and re-catalogue) and every assignment that relied on the label is reviewed.

PRIOR_KNOWLEDGE_NOT_DIAGNOSTIC|MAJOR.issue: The prerequisite is mentioned but not diagnosed with a fallback, so learners without it fall behind unseen.
PRIOR_KNOWLEDGE_NOT_DIAGNOSTIC|MAJOR.proposedCorrection: Turn activation into a diagnostic item per prerequisite and state what happens when a learner misses it.

PROXY_SUBJECT_DECISION_REQUIRED|MAJOR.issue: Objectives can only be traced through a broader MOE subject (see evidence); that mapping is a curriculum-owner decision, not an MOE fact.
PROXY_SUBJECT_DECISION_REQUIRED|MAJOR.proposedCorrection: Record the owner's decision to trace this subject through the named MOE subject before release; candidate work may proceed.

RAW_HTML_IN_LEARNER_TEXT|MINOR.issue: Raw HTML bypasses the V3 renderer's typography and accessibility.
RAW_HTML_IN_LEARNER_TEXT|MINOR.proposedCorrection: Convert to markdown or structured scene fields.

READING_LEVEL_ABOVE_GRADE|MAJOR.issue: Sentence and word length suggest the text is harder to read than the grade allows.
READING_LEVEL_ABOVE_GRADE|MAJOR.proposedCorrection: Shorten sentences and gloss vocabulary without lowering the conceptual demand; confirm with a language reviewer.

READING_LEVEL_ABOVE_GRADE|MINOR.issue: Sentence and word length suggest the text is harder to read than the grade allows.
READING_LEVEL_ABOVE_GRADE|MINOR.proposedCorrection: Shorten sentences and gloss vocabulary without lowering the conceptual demand; confirm with a language reviewer.

REASONING_TASK_WITHOUT_RUBRIC|MINOR.issue: Reasoning prompts exist but nothing says what good reasoning looks like, so they cannot be scored consistently.
REASONING_TASK_WITHOUT_RUBRIC|MINOR.proposedCorrection: Attach a short analytic rubric (protected) to each reasoning task.

REVOKED_CONTENT|BLOCKING.issue: Revoked content cannot be modernized or redelivered without a governance decision.
REVOKED_CONTENT|BLOCKING.proposedCorrection: Confirm retirement; map dependants to a replacement through the legacy mapping plan.

SCHOOL_OR_TEACHER_OWNED|BLOCKING.issue: Teacher- or school-owned content cannot be rewritten by the national pipeline without its owner.
SCHOOL_OR_TEACHER_OWNED|BLOCKING.proposedCorrection: Hold; offer the owner a modernized national alternative instead.

SEQUENCE_OUT_OF_ORDER|MINOR.issue: Practice or assessment appears before the instruction it depends on.
SEQUENCE_OUT_OF_ORDER|MINOR.proposedCorrection: Reorder to explain → model → guided → independent → check.

SERIALIZATION_ARTIFACT|MAJOR.issue: Content was lost when the lesson was saved; learners see a placeholder instead of the material (often worked examples).
SERIALIZATION_ARTIFACT|MAJOR.proposedCorrection: Recover the lost material from an earlier source revision if one exists; otherwise rewrite it. Treat the affected sections as missing.

STUB_CONTENT|BLOCKING.issue: The revision is a stub: there is not enough content to teach the stated objective.
STUB_CONTENT|BLOCKING.proposedCorrection: Replace with a full candidate lesson (Track C); keep the legacy revision for history.

TEMPLATE_SHELL|BLOCKING.issue: Much of the lesson is template text shared across the library rather than instruction specific to this objective.
TEMPLATE_SHELL|BLOCKING.proposedCorrection: Rebuild the teaching sequence for this objective (Track C).

TEMPLATE_SHELL|MAJOR.issue: Much of the lesson is template text shared across the library rather than instruction specific to this objective.
TEMPLATE_SHELL|MAJOR.proposedCorrection: Replace template passages with objective-specific explanation and examples (Track B).

TEXT_LOAD_EXCEEDS_EMERGENT_READER_BUDGET.issue: Emergent readers cannot work through this much text; the lesson depends on reading it can't assume.
TEXT_LOAD_EXCEEDS_EMERGENT_READER_BUDGET.proposedCorrection: Rebuild as short teacher-led scenes with oral, pictorial and concrete activities (Track B).

THIN_CONCEPT_EXPLANATION|MAJOR.issue: The core idea is barely explained before practice begins.
THIN_CONCEPT_EXPLANATION|MAJOR.proposedCorrection: Add an explicit explanation of the concept with a representation (diagram, model or example) before worked examples.

TOO_MANY_SCENES|MINOR.issue: The lesson would paginate into more scenes than one sitting supports.
TOO_MANY_SCENES|MINOR.proposedCorrection: Consolidate or split into two lessons.

UNKEYED_ASSESSMENT_ITEMS|MAJOR.issue: Unkeyed items cannot be scored consistently or verified for correctness.
UNKEYED_ASSESSMENT_ITEMS|MAJOR.proposedCorrection: Write a protected key or rubric for every item and verify each key independently.

UNSOURCED_CLAIM:CITED_STUDY_OR_REPORT|MA.issue: A factual or statistical claim is stated without a source; it may be invented.
UNSOURCED_CLAIM:CITED_STUDY_OR_REPORT|MA.proposedCorrection: Verify against a named, dated source and cite it, or remove it or label it as an invented example.

UNSOURCED_CLAIM:DATED_STATISTIC|MAJOR.issue: A factual or statistical claim is stated without a source; it may be invented.
UNSOURCED_CLAIM:DATED_STATISTIC|MAJOR.proposedCorrection: Verify against a named, dated source and cite it, or remove it or label it as an invented example.

UNSOURCED_CLAIM:INSTITUTIONAL_ATTRIBUTIO.issue: A factual or statistical claim is stated without a source; it may be invented.
UNSOURCED_CLAIM:INSTITUTIONAL_ATTRIBUTIO.proposedCorrection: Verify against a named, dated source and cite it, or remove it or label it as an invented example.

UNVERIFIED_ALIGNMENT_CODES|MAJOR.issue: Alignment codes are LiberiaLearn-invented labels, not MOE objectives; they must not be presented as MOE requirements.
UNVERIFIED_ALIGNMENT_CODES|MAJOR.proposedCorrection: Map each objective to a structured MOE objective id with source page, reviewed by a curriculum owner; lexical leads are attached to this audit.

WAEC_TAGS_UNVERIFIED|MAJOR.issue: No verified WAEC syllabus source is held in the repository, so examination alignment cannot be stated beyond 'topic may be relevant'.
WAEC_TAGS_UNVERIFIED|MAJOR.proposedCorrection: Obtain and register the official WAEC syllabus for the subject, then map with stated specificity and NOT_CLAIMED status.

WIDE_TABLE|MINOR.issue: Tables with more than five columns overflow at 390px and are hard to navigate by screen reader.
WIDE_TABLE|MINOR.proposedCorrection: Split or transpose the table; give it a caption.

WORKED_EXAMPLE_WITHOUT_STEPS|MINOR.issue: Worked examples state answers without showing the reasoning steps.
WORKED_EXAMPLE_WITHOUT_STEPS|MINOR.proposedCorrection: Show each step and why it is taken.
